description: Invite someone to collaborate on a doc the user OWNS, by email, so it lands in their docfarm. If they're already a docfarm user the doc appears in their farm immediately; if not, it waits until they sign up with that address, and the result says whether an invite email went out. REQUIRES the collaborator's `email` AND `allow_overwrite` (true = their edits overwrite the original; false = their edits fork into a copy they own, auto-shared back to the inviter). If you don't have the email, ask for it. If the user hasn't said whether the person should edit directly or only make a copy, ask before calling, don't guess. Identify the doc via `doc_name` (fuzzy-matched) or `slug`.

account.description: Email address of the farm to act on. Omit for the signed-in farm. Only a connected account is accepted; call list_accounts to see which.

allow_overwrite.description: true = collaborator's edits overwrite the original; false = edits fork into a copy they own (auto-shared back to the inviter).

doc_name.description: Name of the doc to share.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite.

slug.description: Share-link slug or full URL. Alternative to doc_name.

name: invite_collaborator
title: Invite a collaborator
